credits.heading: Credits & Acknowledgments
credits.description: Huge thanks to the open-source projects, icon sets, fonts, and services that make this site possible.
credits.thankYouText: We're grateful to all maintainers, contributors, and communities behind these tools and services. If we missed anyone, please let us know and we'll add the credit.

items.nuxtHub: file storage, cache, database, KV, and browser features
items.unocss: utility CSS with Wind3, Attributify, Tagify, Icons, and Animations presets
items.iconify: icon system: Phosphor, Lucide, Tabler, Radix Icons, and Line-MD
items.googleFonts: webfonts: Oi, Manrope, Fraunces, and Playwrite FR Moderne
